mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.password AS password, up.id AS userPolicyId, t.id AS tenantId, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, t.status AS tenantStatus FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_policy up ON up.user_id = u.id AND up.target_type = 'USER' AND up.is_default = true AND up.status = 'ENABLED' AND up.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = up.target_id AND t.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' WHERE u.user_name = #{username} AND u.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED'

SELECT t.id AS tenantId, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, t.status AS tenantStatus, up.status AS userPolicyStatus FROM sys_user_policy up INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = up.target_id AND t.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.target_type = 'USER' AND up.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED'
